The '''Sirpar Hills''' were the terraced hillsides surrounding the [[Anaxes Citadel]] in [[Pols Anaxes]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. As with the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] most vehicles were banned in the Sirpar Hills, so residents would switch out their vehicles for [[Keffi/Legends|Keffis]] at the nearby [[Sirpar Station]]. 

These were covered with the estates of wealthy families who had rich naval backgrounds, in the [[Azure Imperium]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], and the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. The [[Wermis family|Wermis]] and [[Banjeer family|Banjeer]] had their mansions there, along with smaller manses of [[Holt family|Holts]] and [[Ozzel family/Legends|Ozzels]].<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
